notes: τά takes the determiner and the supplied nominal 'the … things' headed on the nominal (rules 49, 102), leaving the substantival adjective bare.

The supplied appositional 'even' is its own added unit because the appositive is carried by an articular phrase whose article rule 20 has already emptied; rule 105's article-carrier arm forbids folding it there. This differs from ROM.1.4 only because the carrier class differs, which rule 105 expressly permits.
ποίημα is headed on 'things' by analogy with rule 66's κτίσμα → 'created thing'; the competing head 'made' is named in the unit note.
